disclaimers.uncertainty: Approximate error estimate based on held-out validation metrics (RMSE = 4.62 MPa, MAE = 3.03 MPa); not a certified confidence interval.
disclaimers.specimen_geometry: The UCI dataset (Yeh, 1998) reports laboratory cylinder compressive strength in MPa across multiple curing ages. When comparing against EN 206 classes (e.g. C25/30), distinguish 150×300 mm cylinder strength (25 MPa) from 150 mm cube strength (30 MPa).
